capabilities: preview STL, OBJ, and 3MF files in notes
open supported 3D model files in a custom viewer
insert viewer blocks from the command palette
rotate and zoom models with the mouse and view cube
extras: STEP/STP CAD files are not rendered directly and must be converted to STL, OBJ, or 3MF first; large models may load slowly and 3MF support covers only common mesh-based files.
problem: Obsidian cannot preview local 3D model files such as STL, OBJ, or 3MF directly inside notes.
summary: Local 3D model viewer that previews STL, OBJ, and 3MF files inside notes with mouse rotation, zooming, and automatic centering.
